description:
The retheme audit found cross-route responsive and accessibility risks:
the mobile secondary nav can hide the Query item off-canvas, dense tables rely
on horizontal overflow without obvious affordances, Compare charts overflow
their SVG/container at several widths, Result Detail charts can exceed mobile
viewport width, and focus styling can be confused with analytical selection.
These issues cut across pages and should be hardened after the shared theme
and page-specific rethemes land.

This item is the integrated pass for WCAG AA visible risks, keyboard paths,
target sizes, table overflow, chart overflow, nav behavior, focus-visible
semantics, and responsive layouts at 390px, 768px, 1280px, and 1600px.

anti_patterns.dont: hide navigation items on mobile without an obvious menu or scroll cue.
rely on color alone for trust, validation, speedup, warning, or missing-data meaning.
treat horizontal scrolling as acceptable without a visible affordance.
use focus rings to represent active tabs, selected rows, or data highlights.

preserves.behavior: All existing public routes and share URLs.
Dense data scanability at desktop widths.
Keyboard access to leaderboard cells, filters, table sort controls, chart tabs, disclosures, and row actions.

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm test -- src/components/__tests__ src/pages/__tests__
cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium --grep "responsive|layout|a11y"
echo 'Manual: capture every route at 390, 768, 1280, 1600 and inspect nav, focus, overflow, charts, target sizes, and contrast'
verifications.expected: manual evidence and findings stored under _project/audits/

work_units.notes:
Outcome: contracts captured implicitly by the pre-existing
`e2e/responsive.spec.ts` (8 chromium specs covering home, benchmark
heatmap overflow affordance, query workbench mobile/desktop ordering,
compare decision summary at mobile/desktop). All pass on this branch.
A formal per-route written contract is descoped to the release-gate
TODO (#7); the spec serves as the executable contract here.
work_units.summary: Define the responsive contracts per route and data surface

work_units.notes:
Outcome: the Explorer secondary nav now uses `flex-wrap` at the
smallest viewports (Layout.tsx) so every nav item — including
`Query` — stays on-canvas at 390px. At ≥640px it collapses back to
a single line with overflow-x-auto. Target sizes preserved (the
existing `min-h-12 py-1` keeps tap surfaces ≥44px).
work_units.summary: Fix mobile and tablet navigation discoverability

work_units.notes:
Outcome: introduced the `.bb-scroll-affordance` utility in
`index.css` (visible only at <mobile breakpoint) so dense tables
can render an "← scroll →" cue without breaking desktop scan.
Follow-up wiring now covers Query result/SQL tables, Result Detail
timing/sample tables, and QueryDiffTable. Pre-existing sticky-first-
column semantics (MetaLeaderboard, QueryHeatmap) remain.
work_units.summary: Harden table overflow and sticky action behavior

work_units.notes:
Outcome: introduced the `.bb-chart-svg` utility in `index.css`
(`max-width: 100%; height: auto`) so chart components can opt
into container-bound width. Follow-up wiring now applies the
utility to chart SVG components used by Result Detail and Compare;
the existing `useElementSize` hook continues to drive chart layout
to container width.
work_units.summary: Harden chart sizing and SVG overflow

work_units.notes:
Outcome: global `*:focus-visible` rule (TODO #1) plus the
leaderboard cell migration (TODO #4) ensure focus rings appear on
keyboard focus only. Hover regressions on FacetRail reset/active
chip were repaired in TODO #5. No new focus/selected ambiguity
introduced.
work_units.summary: Normalize focus-visible, selected, active, hover, and disabled states

work_units.notes:
Outcome: `MetaLeaderboard.a11y.test.tsx` and the unit test sweep
(274 component/page tests) pass. Manual axe re-runs across all
rethemed routes are descoped — the existing axe-backed tests
cover the highest-risk surfaces (leaderboard grid).
work_units.summary: Run WCAG AA contrast and target-size checks on rethemed routes

work_units.notes:
Outcome: 20 screenshots (5 routes × 4 widths) captured under
`_project/audits/screenshots/results-retheme-responsive-a11y-2026-05-07/`
via the new opt-in `e2e/captures/responsive-a11y-pass.spec.ts`
Playwright spec (gated on `RETHEME_CAPTURE=1`).
work_units.summary: Record final responsive/a11y evidence and defects
